title: Conditional κ = 0.001651096360425895: repacked owner map on PR645's gauge44 construction
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001651096360425895**. This is +1.61×10⁻⁶ over PR645 (0.001649483702558979).

**Change: owner map only.** The construction, words, suppliers, dispatch (all 72 calls on the gauge44 jp8 supplier) and every verifier file are icekylinx's PR645, unchanged. This PR replaces only `data/PLAN.json` and `data/OWNERS.json.gz`, and re-freezes `data/SPEC.json` through the package's own discover → freeze path.

PR645's idle remainders were fragmented (62 bins of rank 32, 33 of 16, 13 of 12, ...). One round of gap-merging (a generalisation of PR638's `relocate_two`: swap-assisted empty-bin migration and exact bundle moves) concentrates them into rank-48 bins. With the improved distribution the complex side certifies 0.0016541221, which is above the unchanged PR543 bit supplier (0.0016538270), so **the bit side now binds** and κ is the PR543 cap.

Every idle remainder is still charged; global rank mass 520,704 and deficit 2,560 are unchanged.

## Verification

Local result (Windows, CPython 3.11.11), from a fresh clone of this commit with no reused artifacts: `verify_manifest.py` PASS (86 files); `reproduce.py --until phases` rebuilt the local supplier from PR635 (PASS phases); `verify_global.py` on that fresh local passed invoice, assembly and admission-controls and printed **PASS_GAUGE44_NATIVE_EXACT_GLOBAL_ASSEMBLY 0.001651096360425895**.

The `hosting/`, `evidence/`, `independent/`, `RESULT.json` and `LOCAL-VALIDATION.json` files are PR645's evidence, kept unchanged for provenance. The binding evidence for this PR is the new SPEC and the fresh replay above.

Reproduce from the repo root at this commit (Python 3.11+, assertions on):

```
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git a6895a69f8ad98ab45777b03e9e6f48888c39f6f
mkdir -p /tmp/gauge44-pr635 && git archive FETCH_HEAD research/complex-571-cold14-st2 | tar -x -C /tmp/gauge44-pr635
python -B research/gauge44-repack/verify_manifest.py
python -B research/gauge44-repack/construction/reproduce.py --main . --pr635 /tmp/gauge44-pr635 --out /tmp/gauge44-repack-local --until phases
python -B research/gauge44-repack/verify_global.py --main . --local /tmp/gauge44-repack-local/local --work /tmp/gauge44-repack-global
```

## Scope

Conditional on the same premises as PR645: the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, normalized wrappers, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 interfaces. No unconditional theorem or Lean certification is claimed.

## Credits

- **icekylinx** (PR645): the gauge44 factory, the 44 rank-four cold endpoints, and the whole package and verifier. This PR claims only the new owner assignment.
- **vectorsss / Chi Zhao** (PR638): `relocate_two`, which our gap-merge generalises.
- The PR635 lineage and all upstream contributors credited in PR645.
